name: bug
description: Something behaves wrong

name: enhancement
description: New capability or API change

name: driver-request
description: A new chip driver

name: security
description: Hardening; vulnerabilities go through a private advisory instead

name: standard
description: Brings the repository in line with the engineering standard

name: documentation
description: Docs only

name: ci
description: Workflows and tooling

name: dependencies
description: Dependency and action updates

description: Needs a run on real hardware before release

name: good first issue
description: Small and well described

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers would welcome a pull request

name: question
description: Better asked in Discussions

name: wontfix
description: Not planned

name: board-request
description: A new board, library part or circuit block

name: erratum
description: A known anomaly in a released design or a datasheet; listed in its errata

name: port-request
description: A new port, MCU family or target

name: needs-datasheet

name: duplicate

name: agent:ready
